author: Myv
body:
As a big fan of CTH and a person who wishes to expand the community of CTH, I have some suggestions on the Demo kit, which is a very fun to me but infamous to others type of kit.

I know that it recently got nerfed to having 1 grenade again after it having 3, and lots of people complained. I did not, because I had some really hilarious times using it with 3 nades, but I completely understand why this has happened.

However, I feel as if it is rather underwhelming now, so I have some suggestions.

Shoutout to NinjaSmacker508 for coming up with these suggestions and letting me post them, thanks man!

1. Regeneration - The first idea suggests that one egg should respawn every 15 seconds. This means that if you survive, you can carry on receiving egg bombs occasionally, which is nice. However I know there is a flaw in that people will simply camp for a while and gain 5 or 6 eggs, then rush in, using them all, then go back to spawn and wait for them to regen again. Please take this into consideration if you try to test this.

2. Kills for Eggs - this is my personal favourite idea, in that the player must kill someone with something that is NOT an egg grenade to gain another one - this means if you kill someone with an egg, you will not gain another one. This means you will still have to fight with a sword to get eggs and kills, which means you need to have a wide range of skills to use the kit to its full potential.

3. Capping Hill - if you control the hill when the anvil sounds, you gain an egg from this. This is good because it still requires skill to get in the hill.

Again, I did not come up with these ideas, thanks to Ninja for brainstorming these.

If any of these were to be implemented, only implement 1, 2 may be too OP and definitely not all 3.

Thanks for reading, 

Myv.
